item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Legal and Institutional Aspects of the History of the Italian Judiciary (19th–20th Centuries) (Univ. TORINO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-11 13:00
Institution: Univ. TORINO, Turin
Field: Law / 12/GIUR-16 Storia del diritto medievale e moderno

The research aims to examine, in light of its historical antecedents, the evolution of the legal framework governing the judiciary in the Kingdom of Sardinia and, subsequently, in unified Italy, up to the developments of the post-Second World War period, with particular emphasis on the recruitment of judges and the resulting socio-cultural implications. To this end, the research will involve the following activities: 1. The examination of the primary sources and the archival and bibliographical materials relevant to the research; 2. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: The DNSH Principle and the Transformation of Public Procurement: Administrative Discretion, Environmental Sustainability and the Evolving Responsibilities of Contracting Authorities (Univ. TORINO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-11 13:00
Institution: Univ. TORINO, Turin
Field: Law / 12/GIUR-06 Diritto amministrativo e pubblico

The research will examine the role of the Do No Significant Harm (DNSH) principle in the evolution of EU environmental law and sustainable public procurement. It will investigate the principle’s legal nature, its relationship with sustainable development, environmental integration and EU policy coherence, and its implications for administrative discretion and the responsibilities of contracting authorities. Through doctrinal and comparative legal analysis, the project will explore the regulatory and administrative mechanisms for integrating DNSH throughout the public procurement lifecycle, considering developments in EU sustainable finance and public expenditure frameworks.
